heading: Connect an Agent
intro: Paste one of these into each Agent that should reach Maibuk. The snippet carries this Plugin's address and Key.
newKeyNote: Agents using the old Key stop working until you paste the new one again.
unavailable: The Plugin Endpoint is not available, so there is no address to connect to yet.
reconnect: Maibuk's address changed. Copy the refreshed snippet into each Agent to reconnect.
